answer: Make a carrier-verified phone number the admission ticket: at enrollment, send a fresh OTP, bind one active epoch credential per number and reject reuse. Verify the provider's signed delivery receipt instead of trusting typed claims. Proposed cost—not a current protocol rule—is /bin/bash.10 per SMS. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.10 once; 1,000 fake identities need separate numbers and cost 00 (1,000 × /bin/bash.10). The OTP can echo dawn, karst and juniper as a fresh phrase. Limitation: SIM farms and recycled numbers can still bypass uniqueness.
